description: Powerful Performance: Runs on Google's latest Tensor G5 processor with 12 GB RAM, offering smooth multitasking, fast app launches, and enhanced AI features. Stunning Display: Features a 6.3-inch FHD+ Actua OLED display with 120 Hz refresh rate, 3000 nits peak brightness, and Gorilla Glass Victus 2 for a bright, fluid, and durable screen experience. Smart Camera System: Equipped with a 48 MP main camera, 13 MP ultra-wide, and 10.8 MP telephoto (5× optical zoom), plus a 10.5 MP front camera—perfect for crisp photos, videos, and selfies in any light. Long-Lasting Battery: Packs a 4,970 mAh battery that supports 30W wired fast charging, 15W Qi2 wireless charging, and reverse wireless charging for powering other devices. Built for the Future: Comes with Android 16 and guarantees 7 years of software and security updates, IP68 water/dust resistance, and a sleek Indigo finish—made to last and stay updated.
